knownLimitations: Status values record the state observed at authoring time. An inherited blocker is never closed by this file; only the named owner with real external evidence may close one.
The MC-17 independent review had not been performed when this file was authored; entry MC17-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW is therefore PENDING, not passed.

Severity here is the severity recorded by the originating milestone. Where the originating milestone records a category instead (for example 'informational residual'), that category is preserved in the severity field.
